description.description: An image featuring a portrait of a younger Donald Trump wearing a suit and red tie, overlaid with a block of text containing a fabricated quote attributed to him from People Magazine in 1998 regarding Republican voters.
description.ocrText: “If I were to run, I'd run as a Republican. They're the dumbest group of voters in the country. They believe anything on Fox News. I could lie and they'd still eat it up. I bet my numbers would be terrific.” Donald Trump People Magazine, 1998
